title: CanonicalEventEnvelope
description: Event envelope v1.2.0 as recorded in a run bundle's events.jsonl. Recorded lines add prev_hash and hash (the event hash chain). Ingest also accepts v1.0 envelopes whose payload is a JSON string in payload_json; those are converted on receipt and never recorded in that form.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds. Logical simulation time in experiments; wall time is in provenance.json.

source.description: Producing component, e.g. pordenone.kernel or mesh.lab.

correlation_id.description: Groups every event of one decision.

causation_id.description: event_id of the direct cause, or the run config hash for the first event.

provenance.description: Component version and, where applicable, the evidence the event was derived from.

mode.description: SIMULATED, LIVE, or REPLAY. Unlabeled data defaults to SIMULATED.

ai_involved.description: True when a probabilistic or remote model produced or influenced the event.
